planSteps.description: Open the labeled sample journal and navigate to Archive & restore.
Fetch /test-fixtures/valid-archive.zip from the same origin and select its bytes in the RoomTrace ZIP input.
Assert that all archive verification checks pass and Restore as new journal is enabled.
Restore the verified packet as a separate journal.
Assert that both the original sample journal and restored fixture journal remain available.
Open Compare and assert that the restored Kitchen arrival/departure pair retains its exact baseline link.
